decisions.reason: After only one year, uncertainty about the compact dumper's market is still high and keeping it is relatively inexpensive, so the firm holds the option open.
The articulated dumper is still an unproven option with unresolved market uncertainty, and the firm can afford to wait for more information before committing further.
The mine rescue vehicle is highly specialized but its prospects remain uncertain, and as long as the cost of keeping it is low the firm maintains the option.
The compact telescopic loader has broader market appeal and still unresolved upside, so the firm keeps this option while learning more about its value.
